description: Finding 9, as the port does it: streaming a short value serves the cursor's own slot, with or without a position, so each of the three keys streams: the one reached by sorted_map_get with key, and a set's key-only entry's key from read_key_value_pair on sorted_map_get with kv_pair in a read path, read-only and after a writable init has retagged the set as a map.

ops.note: what getKeyValuePair does: the entry in a read path, which leaves a key-only entry where it is, with no position
a writable init as a map, which retags the set
what getKeyValuePair does: the entry in a read path, which leaves a key-only entry where it is, with no position
